feature.label: General SEM PLS Three-Way Moderation Full-Model Case Bootstrap

claim.supported_scope: One true three-way interaction in a recursive, single-group composite PLS model with complete stage-1/stage-2 case-bootstrap refits, one shared ledger, and percentile Type-7 inference.
claim.estimand: Two-sided percentile Type-7 inference for the jointly refitted X-by-W-by-Z coefficient, conditional X-by-W effects at fixed Z probes, and X simple slopes over the fixed W-by-Z grid, all governed by one shared replicate ledger.
assumptions: The resident model satisfies the exact one-term, two-stage, strong-hierarchy predicate of the three-way point cell.
Every usable bootstrap replicate refits the complete stage-1 and stage-2 model and jointly estimates main, pairwise and three-way terms.
Replicate indices, replacement sampling, percentile Type-7 intervals and the usable threshold follow the frozen General SEM convention.
exclusions: A second three-way term, fourth-order interactions, HOC interactions, three-way moderated mediation and Johnson-Neyman regions are excluded.
BCa, studentized, one-sided and permutation inference, groups, weights, clusters and non-listwise inputs are excluded.
The observed-variable PROCESS workflow is separate and is not claimed by this latent-variable PLS cell.
warnings: This exact bounded cell is scoped Standard under quickpls_v253_streamlined_integration_v1; all exclusions and corrective fail-closed behavior remain in force.
SmartPLS documentation is used only as a terminology and observable-workflow benchmark; QuickPLS is independently implemented.

equations.expression: fit_b = refit_pls_and_joint_hierarchy(case_sample(seed,b)); theta_b = {bxwz_b, bxw_b + bxwz_b*z0, bx_b + bxw_b*w0 + bxz_b*z0 + bxwz_b*w0*z0}
ci_j = quantile_type7({theta_jb for shared usable b}, [alpha/2, 1-alpha/2])

references.citation: Dawson and Richter (2006), Probing Three-Way Interactions in Moderated Multiple Regression: Development and Application of a Slope Difference Test
QuickPLS 2.53 validation-only single-path and three-way compact reference matrix

simulations.design: Compact continuous-continuous and binary-continuous strong-hierarchy fixtures with explicit indexed resamples, fixed probes, worker replay and one failed-fit boundary; the independent reference refits every replicate.
simulations.seed_policy: Frozen scenario seed and explicit replicate-index streams; failed fits remain in the shared ledger and are never silently retried under a new index.
simulations.acceptance_rule: Point and every usable replayed target agree within 1e-10; intervals agree within 1e-10 and ledger plus worker replay identities agree exactly.

boundaries.case: A resample makes a main score, product or joint equation constant, nonfinite or singular.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Record one typed failed replicate, continue the indexed traversal and publish only if the shared usable threshold passes.

boundaries.case: The model requests another three-way term, missing hierarchy, HOC interaction, moderated mediation, unsupported binary coding or an unsupported inference option.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Preserve the model and return one corrective blocked decision without silently simplifying it.

boundaries.case: Rows or declarations are consistently reordered, or the supported worker count changes.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Mapped scientific results remain equivalent and indexed replicate identities remain deterministic.

boundaries.case: The same resident authority, data, seed, replicate count and worker count are rerun.
boundaries.expected_behavior: The scientific payload and shared failure ledger are identical apart from operational identifiers and timestamps.

boundaries.case: A point value, replicate count, failure ledger, interval, probe, method version or cell identity is altered.
boundaries.expected_behavior: Strict validation rejects the archive and exposes no changed completed result.

tamper_tests.expected_behavior: Reject a result whose three-way bootstrap cell or point authority differs from its compiled authority.
Reject a result relabelled with a two-way or point-only method version.
Reject a result whose resident dataset fingerprint differs.
Reject a changed archive member, presentation mapping or canonical attachment digest.
Reject duplicate keys, nonfinite values, missing targets or incoherent shared bootstrap ledgers.
Never reinterpret a historical two-way bootstrap or visible interaction node as this new exact identity.

persistence.legacy_policy: Older moderation results preserve their original identities; this cell applies only to a newly executed exact three-way general_sem_v1 authority.

applicability_blockers: HOC interaction or three-way moderated mediation
native.gui_cli_parity_rule: For the same resident authority, data, seed and recipe, every surface reads the same canonical point, interval, shared ledger and exact cell identity.
accessibility_rules: Context menu and M shortcut provide non-drag alternatives; anchors have descriptive accessible names.
Dash and marker shape supplement color, and every chart has an accessible source table.
